r_hymn_extended.text: PSALTER SPIRES: Tonight's Crown Hymn broadcast extended one hour. Attendance is devotion. Devotion is recorded.

r_border_held.text: Iron Choir legions report the border 'held with song.' Casualty figures are being reconciled with the Libraries.

r_splitter.text: Veil's so-called Circuit-Splitter sighted near the eastern salvage belt. Citizens reminded: the Doctrine has a hymn.

r_memory_hygiene.text: Veil's Ministry of Clear History calls erased cities 'memory hygiene.' The Doctrine remembers what Veil forgets.

r_output_up.text: Munitions output up 4% this cycle. Mourning Days reduced accordingly. Grief is a shared resource.

r_omen_six.text: Explosion at a supply works: Greywrithe saboteur Kestral Omen-Six suspected. Again.

r_humane_infra.text: Veil unveils 'humane infrastructure.' Cantors warn: they want to meter your soul.

r_off_key.text: Reminder: unregistered hymns are not hymns. Report off-key neighbours to your Cantor.

r_casualty_count.text: My cousin swears a Veil medic stitched her up at the border. Then shot the guy next to her. Or didn't. Two stories.

r_cant_sing.text: Kid in my brother's legion can't sing. They make him march at the back and mouth it.

r_who_made_us.text: Heard a Choir android asked a Cantor 'Who made us?' out loud. Nobody's seen it since. Or everybody has.

r_coffins.text: Quartermaster down the depot loses whole crates of coffins. Full ones. Nobody audits a coffin.

r_weeping_circuit.text: Drank from the Weeping Circuit once. Woke up remembering someone else's wedding. Better than mine.

r_second_draft.text: Old-timer says we're the second draft of humanity. I say this beer is the second draft of beer.

r_god_questions.text: A GOD WHO FEARS QUESTIONS IS ONLY A KING.

r_two_shadows.text: Every face casts two shadows. Hers has a pension.

r_tip_him.text: The Library remembers. The heart misfiles. The bartender forgets. — tip him.

r_still_waiting.text: We are still here. We are still waiting.
